assets: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a production background for a Persian children's 2D attention-training game. Create a beautiful cohesive handcrafted storybook game environment, polished flat shapes, subtle gouache-paper grain, delicate moss-ink outlines, rounded friendly forms, soft natural light, muted sophisticated pastel colors. Landscape 1536x1024. The middle 65% is deliberately quiet and mostly empty so separately rendered interactive objects remain easy to distinguish. Edge details only. The scene must work cropped to a tall central mobile viewport as well as wide desktop. No text, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI, borders, people, animals, collectible items, tools, toys, buttons, cards, spacecraft or boats. Not a screenshot. Keep central foreground light and low contrast. Scene: a welcoming coastal rescue adventure. Warm sandy shore occupies the central and upper-middle playable ground, calm turquoise water curves through the bottom fifth, distant soft hills and pale sky across the upper fifth. Sparse rounded shoreline rocks and reeds at outer edges only. Honey sand, sea glass teal, sage, pale peach. Suggest a little wooden pier at the far edge but no vessel. A gentle late-afternoon atmosphere, ample room for equipment to be overlaid on the sand.
